cards.title: Moss Message Observatory Final Copy Card
cards.finalCopySkill: copy a clear opening, selected details, sentence stops, and one short dialogue line into a neat final page
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only spiral notebook final-copy card for copying one fictional moss message observatory story page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out the draft, this card, and one blank spiral notebook page for a calm fictional observatory copy pass: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: copy the pretend moss message story onto paper with a clear opening, useful details, full sentence stops, and one tidy dialogue line: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Opening copy: copy the first sentence so the reader knows who found the moss message and where the observatory waits: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Neat copy: use steady pencil lines, leave small spaces between words, and restart only the sentence you are fixing: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Detail transfer: carry over two helpful observatory details from the draft, such as a pebble lens, moss chart, or signal shelf: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Sentence boundary: check each copied sentence for a capital start and a clear end mark before moving to the next line: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Dialogue copy: copy one short spoken line from the invented watcher with quote marks and a simple said tag: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Final-copy check: mark one opening, two details, three sentence ends, and one dialogue line before calling the page finished: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult points to one draft sentence, and the writer copies only that sentence into the spiral notebook: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: copy another pretend message story on paper, keeping the opening, details, sentence ends, and dialogue easy to follow: ____________________.

cards.title: Revision River Ferry Final Copy Card
cards.finalCopySkill: transfer a revised ferry scene into final copy while preserving paragraph order and exact dialogue punctuation
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only spiral notebook final-copy card for copying one fictional revision river ferry scene after a paper draft pass: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place the revised draft beside a blank spiral notebook page and choose one invented ferry crossing scene to copy: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: copy the ferry scene in order, keep the revised details, and make the final page read like one smooth paper version: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Opening copy: copy the revised opening so the river, ferry helper, and crossing problem are clear in one sentence: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Neat copy: keep margins steady, copy one sentence at a time, and use a single neat pencil fix if a word is missed: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Detail transfer: transfer three important draft details, such as the ferry bell, paper dock, current mark, or folded ticket: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Sentence boundary: pause at every end mark and check that long ferry sentences do not run together: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Dialogue copy: copy one ferry-helper dialogue line with quote marks, a comma before the said tag when needed, and clear spacing: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Final-copy check: confirm the opening, detail order, sentence endings, dialogue marks, and last line all match the revised plan: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult covers the later draft lines, and the writer copies only the first ferry paragraph on paper: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: copy another pretend river scene into a spiral notebook after choosing the details and dialogue that should stay: ____________________.

cards.title: Tiny Lantern Reef Final Copy Card
cards.finalCopySkill: make a final copy that keeps tiny scene details readable and separates each sentence cleanly
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only spiral notebook final-copy card for copying one fictional tiny lantern reef story page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set the draft and card beside a blank spiral notebook page, then choose one gentle reef-lantern moment for final copy: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: copy the pretend reef story carefully so each lantern detail, sentence, and dialogue line is easy to read on paper: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Opening copy: copy the opening sentence so the reader can see the tiny lantern reef and the helper's first job: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Neat copy: write slowly enough for round letters, clear word spaces, and a steady line across the spiral notebook page: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Detail transfer: carry over two tiny reef details from the draft, such as shell steps, glow dots, coral cards, or a paper tide line: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Sentence boundary: after each sentence, touch the end mark with your pencil and check that the next sentence starts cleanly: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Dialogue copy: copy one short reef-helper line with quote marks and a new line if the speaker changes: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Final-copy check: underline the opening, circle two copied details, tap each sentence end, and check the dialogue marks: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult chooses one lantern detail, and the writer copies only the sentence that carries that detail: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: copy another pretend tiny-place story on paper with two kept details and sentence endings that are easy to find: ____________________.

cards.title: Mitten Market Lost Ticket Final Copy Card
cards.finalCopySkill: copy a short final story page with clear word spaces, end marks, and one simple dialogue line
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only spiral notebook final-copy card for copying one fictional mitten market lost-ticket story page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: place the short draft beside a blank spiral notebook page and choose one pretend mitten market ticket moment to copy: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: copy the made-up market story with neat words, clear spaces, sentence ends, and one small dialogue line: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Opening copy: copy the first sentence so it tells who lost the pretend ticket and where the mitten market begins: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Neat copy: keep one finger space between words and copy only one short sentence before checking it: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Detail transfer: copy two helpful market details from the draft, such as a mitten stall, ticket basket, ribbon tag, or bell card: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Sentence boundary: put a clear end mark after each sentence before starting the next one: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Dialogue copy: copy one tiny line a character says about the missing ticket, using quote marks if the adult models them: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Final-copy check: point to the first sentence, two market details, each end mark, and the dialogue line on the finished page: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult reads one short draft line, and the writer copies that line only: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: copy another pretend lost-and-found story on paper with clear spaces and sentence ends: ____________________.

cards.title: Paperclip Plaza Parcel Day Final Copy Card
cards.finalCopySkill: copy a final parcel story page with a clear beginning, useful details, and readable dialogue
cards.useCase: Adult-led offline paper-only spiral notebook final-copy card for copying one fictional paperclip plaza parcel day story page: ____________________.
cards.adultSetup: Adult: set out the draft, this card, and one blank spiral notebook page for a paper-only parcel story copy pass: ____________________.
cards.kidDirection: Writer: copy the pretend parcel story so the beginning, plaza details, sentence ends, and one dialogue line are clear: ____________________.
cards.openingCopyPrompt: Opening copy: copy the beginning sentence so it names the parcel helper and the plaza job for the day: ____________________.
cards.neatCopyPrompt: Neat copy: copy from left to right with steady spaces, then reread the sentence before copying the next one: ____________________.
cards.detailTransferPrompt: Detail transfer: keep two useful parcel details from the draft, such as a paperclip gate, label tray, parcel cart, or corner post: ____________________.
cards.sentenceBoundaryPrompt: Sentence boundary: check that each copied sentence starts with a capital and ends before the next idea begins: ____________________.
cards.dialogueCopyPrompt: Dialogue copy: copy one short line between two pretend plaza helpers with quote marks and the speaker's name nearby: ____________________.
cards.finalCopyCheckPrompt: Final-copy check: check the beginning, two parcel details, sentence starts and ends, and the dialogue line before closing the notebook: ____________________.
cards.quietOptionLine: Quiet option: adult marks one paragraph with a pencil dot, and the writer copies just that paragraph into the spiral notebook: ____________________.
cards.takeHomeLine: Take-home line: copy another pretend parcel note on paper with a clear beginning, two details, and one readable line of dialogue: ____________________.
